name: Qe Reward Points for WooCommerce
author: QeWebby

sections.description:
Qe Reward Points for WooCommerce is a powerful loyalty system that allows store owners to reward customers with points for their purchases.

Customers can earn points based on configurable rules and redeem them during checkout for discounts.

🚀 Key Features (Free)

  • Fixed points per order
  • First order bonus points
  • Minimum order amount for redemption
  • Maximum redeemable points per order
  • Reward history tracking
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce
  • Email templating support

🏆 Premium Features (Pro)

Unlock advanced features with the Pro version:

  • Percentage-based earning
  • Points per currency spent
  • Product-level reward overrides
  • Category-level reward overrides
  • Expiry management support
  • Import/Export functionality
  • Membership system
  • Referral program
  • Create customer account on checkout
  • Decimal reward points support

Additional Information

Check out our other plugins:

  1. 360 Product Viewer for WooCommerce
  2. InstaView for WooCommerce
  3. Qe Ultimate Blocks
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Reward Points to configure options
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I limit the maximum redeemable points?

Yes, you can configure the maximum redeemable points per order in the settings.

Can I set a minimum order amount for redemption?

Yes, redemption can be restricted until a minimum cart value is reached.
